core: 时 marks the moment another action happens — it is not a standalone preposition for 'when'. Learners often overuse it alone, while natives pair it with location words like 的时候 or 前/后 to make clear time clauses.

sentences.pinyin: wǒ zǎoshang méi shíjiān chī zǎofàn.
sentences.en: I don't have time for breakfast in the morning.
sentences.why: A flatmate explains their morning routine; 没时间 is the natural spoken way to say 'too busy' without sounding formal.
sentences.tip: Do not say '我没有时间' here — it sounds stiff in daily chat.

sentences.situation: In a taxi · to the driver
sentences.zh: 请问，到火车站要多长时间？
sentences.pinyin: qǐngwèn, dào huǒchē zhàn yào duō cháng shíjiān?
sentences.en: Excuse me, how long does it take to get to the train station?
sentences.why: A passenger checks travel time before a trip; 多长时间 is the fixed phrase for asking duration.
sentences.tip: Use 请问 at the start to sound natural and respectful.

sentences.zh: 我有时候周末在家做饭。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ yǒu shíhou zhōumò zài jiā zuò fàn.
sentences.en: Sometimes I cook at home on weekends.
sentences.why: A friend shares a casual habit; 有时候 means 'occasionally', not 'all the time'.
sentences.tip: The second 时 in 有时候 is usually spoken as neutral tone shíhou.

sentences.situation: At work · to a new colleague
sentences.zh: 来公司时，记得带身份证。
sentences.pinyin: lái gōngsī shí, jìde dài shēnfènzhèng.
sentences.en: When you come to the office, remember to bring your ID card.
sentences.why: A colleague gives practical advice for a first day; 来...时 is a compact time clause common in work messages.
sentences.tip: In writing you can also say 来公司的时候; both are natural.

sentences.situation: At a restaurant · to the waiter
sentences.pinyin: shàngcài shí, qǐng xiān gàosu wǒmen.
sentences.en: When the dishes are served, please let us know first.
sentences.why: A customer asks the waiter to announce food arrival; this is a soft, polite request, not a complaint.
sentences.tip: Add 请 to keep the request polite rather than demanding.

sentences.pinyin: kāihuì shí, wǒ bù néng kàn shǒujī.
sentences.en: During meetings, I can't look at my phone.
sentences.why: An employee explains why they replied late; 开会时 frames the situation without making excuses.
sentences.tip: This sounds professional; avoid saying 我没看手机 as a blunt denial.

sentences.zh: 你小的时候，我们常去公园。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ xiǎo de shíhou, wǒmen cháng qù gōngyuán.
sentences.en: When you were little, we often went to the park.
sentences.why: A parent recalls the past; 的时候 is the spoken way to mark 'when' for a past period.
sentences.tip: The full 的时候 sounds warmer than the short 时 in family talk.

sentences.situation: In a meeting · presenting to clients
sentences.zh: 同时，我们也在看新的市场。
sentences.pinyin: tóngshí, wǒmen yě zài kàn xīn de shìchǎng.
sentences.en: At the same time, we are also looking at new markets.
sentences.why: A manager links two ongoing actions in a formal update; 同时 is the standard transition word.
sentences.tip: In casual speech, say 还有 or 也; 同时 is more for presentations.

sentences.situation: With a friend · sharing a memory
sentences.zh: 当时我真的不知道怎么办。
sentences.pinyin: dāngshí wǒ zhēnde bù zhīdào zěnme bàn.
sentences.en: At that moment, I really didn't know what to do.
sentences.why: A friend describes a past moment of panic; 当时 refers back to a specific time already mentioned.
sentences.tip: Do not use 当时 for future plans — it always looks backward.

sentences.situation: At a job interview · to the interviewer
sentences.zh: 在国外工作时，我学会了独立。
sentences.pinyin: zài guówài gōngzuò shí, wǒ xuéhuì le dúlì.
sentences.en: While working abroad, I learned to be independent.
sentences.why: A candidate links an experience to a personal quality; 在...时 frames the time period clearly for a professional answer.
sentences.tip: This pattern sounds polished; add 在 before the place to sound more complete.

quiz.prompt: You are talking to a friend. Tell them that sometimes you drink coffee in the morning.
accept: 有时候我早上会喝咖啡。
quiz.explain: 有时候 is the natural spoken phrase for 'sometimes' in daily chat.

quiz.prompt: You are in a taxi. Ask the driver how long it takes to get to the airport.
quiz.answer: 请问，到机场要多长时间？
accept: 请问去机场要多长时间？
quiz.explain: 多长时间 is the standard way to ask duration in Mandarin.

quiz.prompt: You message your boss to explain why you didn't reply during a meeting. Use a polite, honest tone.
quiz.answer: 开会时我不能看手机，所以没及时回您。
accept: 开会时我没看手机，刚刚才看到消息。
开会时不方便看手机，现在回复您。
quiz.explain: 开会时 frames the reason politely without sounding like an excuse.

quiz.prompt: You are at a restaurant and want to politely ask the waiter to tell you when the food arrives. Make it soft, not demanding.
quiz.answer: 上菜时麻烦先告诉我们一下。
accept: 上菜时请先和我们说一声。
菜好了的时候麻烦通知我们一下。
quiz.explain: Adding 麻烦 makes the request polite rather than commanding.

quiz.answer: 我有时候在家看书，有时候和朋友出去吃饭。
accept: 周末我常在家休息，有时候也去爬山。
一般我会运动，有时候在家做饭。
quiz.explain: 有时候 naturally describes occasional habits in answer to a routine question.

quiz.prompt: 你还记得刚来中国的时候吗？那时候感觉怎么样？
quiz.answer: 当时我中文不太好，买东西的时候有点紧张。
accept: 当时我谁都不认识，感觉很孤单。
当时我很兴奋，也有一点害怕。
quiz.explain: 当时 refers back to that past moment and sounds natural in a nostalgic conversation.
